reuse.why: Changes the shared getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, but leaves api-models' private getExpectedScheduleAmount as a separate copy of the range rule instead of routing it through getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: The new 'lowest value' range rule (Math.min(num1, num2)) is written in both shared/schedules.ts and server/api-models.ts; the diff edits the pre-existing duplicate in parallel rather than removing it.

placement.why: The rule changes in the shared amount helper and in the API model where the approximate case already lived; the approximate tolerance rule remains only in the API layer.

scope.why: Small and on-topic; touches only amount rules, their comments and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable, but the next change to the worst-case rule again needs two synchronised edits, and the approximate rule exists only in the API copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/api-models.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount keeps its own range computation instead of calling shared getScheduledAmount (pre-existing, perpetuated by the diff).

disguised_duplication.where: Both copies use the identical Math.min(amount.num1, amount.num2) expression; the duplication is plain, not disguised.
